; ==== RINGS701.SPF
;M01

CICLA:

G01 X40. Y40.
CORNER

CORNER
G01 X240. Y160.
CORNER
G01 X40. Y160.
CORNER

NEXT_L(270.,100.,1,2,3)

G01 X264.895 Y98.538
G01 X264.343 Y98.114
G01 X263.919 Y97.562
G01 X263.653 Y96.919
G01 X263.562 Y96.229
G01 X263.653 Y95.539
G01 X263.919 Y94.895
G01 X264.343 Y94.343
PROFILE
G03 X263.072 Y96. I5.657 J5.657
LASTLINE(0,0,0,1,263.072,96.,264.343,94.343,0,0)
NEXT_L(-7.,0.,1,2,3)
G01 G42 X0. Y0.
PROFILE
G01 X300. Y0.
CORNER
G01 X300. Y200.
CORNER
G01 X0. Y200.
CORNER
LASTLINE(0,0,0,1,0.,200.,0.,0.,0,0)
ENDGEO
IF R16==1
	  STOPRE
	  R16=0
   GOTOB CICLA
ENDIF
ENDPART
RET
